classification.difficultyReason: Apply rounding at the hundredths place, carry through consecutive nines to obtain 10.00, and explain Josh's failure to carry. Preserving two decimal places adds a familiar notation decision.

content.prompt: Josh is rounding $9.999$ to two decimal places. He writes $9.90$. Explain why he is incorrect.

answer.short: The critical digit is $9$, so rounding up carries through the hundredths, tenths and units places: $9.999\approx10.00$.
answer.worked:
Cut after the hundredths place. The critical digit is $9$, so round up. Adding $1$ to the hundredths digit $9$ gives a carry to the tenths place; the carry continues through the tenths and units digits, which are also $9$.
$$9.999\approx10.00$$
Josh has not carried into the higher place values. Keep two decimal places in the answer.
